text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant accepts recommendations for running of Management Systems Unit, set up by the previous government to steer reform in the public service. The new government wants to make the organisation more accountable, cost effective and efficient.

- Finance Ministry drawing up "Plan for a better economy", says Finance Minister Lino Spiteri. Plan aims at better coordination of public spending, bringing in planning and monitoring of spending by state-owned companies.
- Inefficiency and money squandering found in Management Systems Unit.
- Prime Minister makes courtesy call on Bishop of Gozo.
- Casual elections being held, Thursday, to fill seats vacated by candidates elected from two divisions in the October 26 general election.

- Busietta Gardens given go-ahead for development by review board of Planning Authority. Development permits will allow continuation of controversial development of residential blocks in scenic valley, opposed by Prime Minister Alfred Sant when he was still opposition leader.
